intro.text: A Purelake fisherman who rafts around the lake hunting unusual fish.

items.text: Ishikk lived mostly alone on his raft, usually sleeping in Fu Abra. To avoid being pressured into marriage, he gave valuable fish to Maib, owner of a cafe he liked, though he admitted he liked her food and might let her catch him someday.
Three odd foreign men approached Ishikk. Doubting the names they gave, he called them Grump, Blunt and Thinker. He found them strange, as he did most foreigners.
Because he travelled all over the lake, they hired him to look for a man they were seeking. He asked around the villages for at least five months without finding anything.

appearance.text: Wears lake sandals and knee-length breeches, has chin stubble, and goes shirtless to soak up the sun.

personality.text: Unhurried and practical, he loves his life on the Purelake, prefers the sun, keeps his feet in water even when eating, and has no interest in other languages.
